Question
========
What does point B of the elephant curve show?

Answerlist
----------
* Almost no gains among the lower middle classes of rich countries
* The largest gains of the global top 1%
* Falling incomes of the global poor
* The rise of the Asian middle classes

Solution
========
Around the 80th global percentile, mostly lower middle classes in Western Europe and North America, real income barely grew.

Answerlist

* True

* False
